items.t: No official boundary document for the sub-area was opened; the board sub-area code is not verified.

The name on the ground, twice over: the City of Delta lists Pebble Hill Park, 411 Milsom Wynd, in Tsawwassen, and the BC Ministry of Education lists Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary, 246 52a St, among SD37's schools.

Market numbers: none. Pebble Hill is in South Delta, which SnapStats does not cover — its Delta coverage is North Delta only, a different community that is not used here even as context; no inventory, median, sales-ratio or days-on-market figure for Pebble Hill or Tsawwassen can be stated from the sources used.

Transit through the sub-area itself: TransLink route 601's Tsawwassen routing runs via 2 Ave, 52A St, 4 Ave, Milsom Wynd, 6 Ave, 52 St, 8A Ave, 53A St and 12 Ave to 56 St (South Delta Exchange), then via Highway 17, Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) — Milsom Wynd and 52A Street are Pebble Hill Park's and the traditional elementary's streets, so the 601 physically crosses the sub-area.

Recreation anchors: Pebble Hill Park, 411 Milsom Wynd; Winskill Park and the Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre; South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 Street (arena, curling rink, 8,800 sq ft gymnasium, meeting rooms, banquet hall); Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach (Metro Vancouver), with the 17 km Dyke Trail from 17A Ave to Mud Bay.

blocks.text: Good to know about Pebble Hill

items.t: The park sits on top of the water supply. Pebble Hill Park (411 Milsom Wynd) sits partially atop Metro Vancouver reservoirs for the area — and the section under the BC Hydro right-of-way, accessible from Milsom Wynd, is the designated off-leash dog area.

The bus route is the sub-area's street map. Route 601's path via 2 Ave, 52A St, 4 Ave and Milsom Wynd runs past both the park and the elementary school — the clearest official trace of which streets form the pocket's core.

The feed spans two kinds of street. Pebble Hill listings cover both the park / traditional-school streets (52A Street, Milsom Wynd, 4th Avenue) and view streets further west and north (Rosehill Wynd, 54 Street). Whether the board sub-area is one pocket or effectively two is not settled on official sources.

Suites are already the sub-area's attached supply. Several listings in the live feed describe legal suites or in-law suites in detached houses — in a sub-area with no strata buildings, the suite in a house is the rental and multi-generational product buyers actually find here (listing copy, feed evidence only).
There are no Pebble Hill statistics to quote.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Pebble Hill

items.t: OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future", adopted July 8, 2024, is a single consolidated plan with one Land Use Plan; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)".

Flood frame: Tsawwassen's Boundary Bay shore is dike-protected delta land and the Dyke Trail itself runs on the dike; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

Strata rules (for Tsawwassen strata purchases elsewhere): Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59): discloses monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still to be paid, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report attached; the strata must provide it within 7 days of request. Since July 1, 2024 a strata with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years and cannot vote to defer it (a sub-5-lot strata sits UNDER that threshold); since November 1, 2023 the CRF must receive a minimum of 10% of the annual operating fund each year.

Rental and age bylaws (strata): Every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022 — a directory "rentals not allowed" line is void in-entry. Under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1 and 123.2 only a 55+ age bylaw is valid, with exemptions (expanded May 1, 2023) for legacy residents, live-in caregivers, a younger spouse or partner, and defined children of a qualifying resident.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Pebble Hill

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta — Pebble Hill is a sub-area of Tsawwassen, in South Delta, under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024, a single consolidated plan with land-use designations in its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5).

The cards span both the streets around Pebble Hill Park / the traditional school (52A Street, Milsom Wynd, 4th Avenue) and view streets further west and north (Rosehill Wynd, 54 Street) — whether the board sub-area is one pocket or effectively two is a research Section 8 question for Jared, because no official boundary document was opened. Individual card prices are feed data and are not frozen here as market facts.

The name on the ground, twice over: the City lists Pebble Hill Park, 411 Milsom Wynd, in Tsawwassen, and the BC Ministry of Education lists Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary, 246 52a St, Delta, among SD37's schools. Nearby areas named on the page: Tsawwassen homes generally, and Tsawwassen East.

Parks and recreation: Pebble Hill Park, 411 Milsom Wynd — a multi-use park sitting partially atop Metro Vancouver reservoirs, with sport courts, sports fields, trails and washrooms, a section under the BC Hydro right-of-way accessible from Milsom Wynd designated as an off-leash dog area, hours dawn to dusk. Winskill Park sits next to the Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre and features the Lions Wellness Park. South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St, lists an arena, a curling rink, an 8,800 sq ft gymnasium, meeting rooms and a banquet hall. Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver) is Tsawwassen's Boundary Bay shore park — the Dyke Trail runs 17 km from 17A Ave to Mud Bay, the park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area and a critical Pacific Flyway rest stop, and Centennial Beach is its main beach facility.
South Delta Secondary (8–12), 750 53 St, is the Tsawwassen secondary school on the Ministry list — a statement about the school list, not a catchment result. Ministry-listed names only are used here.

Transit through the sub-area itself: route 601's Tsawwassen routing runs via 2 Ave, 52A St, 4 Ave, Milsom Wynd, 6 Ave, 52 St, 8A Ave, 53A St and 12 Ave to 56 St (South Delta Exchange), then via Highway 17, Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) — the 601 physically crosses the sub-area on Pebble Hill Park's and the traditional school's streets.

Market numbers: none. Pebble Hill is in South Delta, and SnapStats publishes no South Delta figures — its Delta coverage is North Delta only, a different community, not used here even as context; neither the FVR nor the GVR September 2026 report has a Tsawwassen section or a Pebble Hill row. Land has no SnapStats category in any case.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Pebble Hill

items.t: SSMUH — this sub-area's real density story: Delta's provincially required zoning updates (SSMUH Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, and the City's Housing Accelerator initiatives include help for owners creating accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites. What a specific Pebble Hill lot can build is a parcel-level check with the City — price the framework, not a promise.

Strata block — stated for completeness, governing no verified Pebble Hill land stock: if a bare-land strata lot were ever the purchase (none is verified here), the BC block would apply to the LOT — Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59) within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid age bylaw.

blocks.text: Good to know about Pebble Hill

items.t: The park sits on top of the water supply. Pebble Hill Park sits partially atop Metro Vancouver reservoirs for the area, and its off-leash section lies under the BC Hydro right-of-way — the pocket's central green is infrastructure land, which is part of why it reads as open space in the middle of a detached-house pocket.

The sub-area may be two pockets wearing one name. The feed spans the park/school streets and higher view streets further west and north, and no official boundary document settles whether they trade as one sub-area — a research question left open for Jared, stated here rather than resolved.
Delta has no Supreme Court registry, so foreclosure mapping for this sub-area is not confirmed.
